title: $j_!$ preserves bounded constructible complexes
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and let $j\colon U\to X$ be an open immersion of
the setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. If $K\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_U})$ is bounded constructible
([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]), then so is the levelwise extension by zero
$D(j_!)K\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$ ([sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek],
[sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]).

proof.text: By [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], $X$ is finite type over $k$. Its space is Noetherian, so every open is retrocompact [def-weil-constructible-subset]; hence $j$ is quasi-compact. Take the reduced closed complement $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ using [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. For any constructible $M$ on $U$, choose strata $s_a:U_a\to U$ from [def-sfb-constructible-module]. Each $s_a$ is closed in an open of $U$, which is open in $X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Thus $js_a$ and $i$ give a finite locally closed partition of $X$ [def-constructible-stratification].

source.place: Proof, finite stratification and reduced closed complement

proof.text: For $g:T\to X$, put $P_g=\operatorname{mapMod}(g^*_{\Ab})$. By [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms] and [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback], $g^*=\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_g}P_g$ with $\alpha_g$ invertible. Thus [lem-sfb-lfp-scalar-isomorphism] identifies local finite presentation of $P_gN$ and $g^*N$, also for maps into $U$. Apply this first to $s_a^*M$. By [lem-sfb-open-module-restriction-identities] and [def-sfb-module-upper-star-comp], $(js_a)^*j_!M\cong s_a^*M$ and $i^*j_!M\cong0$. Apply the scalar lemma in reverse to $js_a$ and $i$. The original local presentations therefore work on the old strata. On $Z$, zero has the rank-zero cokernel presentation on the identity cover [def-sfb-finitely-presented-module, def-sfb-locally-finitely-presented]. Composing presentation isomorphisms with the displayed module isomorphisms proves constructibility on the partition of step 1 [def-sfb-constructible-module].

source.place: Proof, restrictions on original strata and zero on the complement

proof.text: The additive exact functor $j_!$ [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek] acts termwise on complexes [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] gives $H^q(D(j_!)K)\cong j_!H^q(K)$. An additive functor sends zero to zero (the image identity is zero). The finite cohomological interval of $K$ [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible] therefore also bounds $D(j_!)K$.

source.place: Proof, first two sentences: exactness and cohomology

proof.text: Each $H^q(K)$ is constructible [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible], so step 2 applies. The cohomology isomorphism of step 3 preserves constructibility: in [def-sfb-constructible-module] use the same strata and covers and compose the presentation isomorphisms. Together with the same finite interval this is exactly bounded constructibility. Empty strata may be omitted; ranks zero handle zero modules and the zero ring.
